prompt:
You are a scientific-replication judge. Evaluate whether an independent
reproduction on RefSeq NC_000964.3 (the 2009 unified reference for the same
B. subtilis 168 strain) supports the quantitative claims of:

Kunst F. et al. (1997) "The complete genome sequence of the Gram-positive
bacterium Bacillus subtilis." Nature 390:249-256, doi:10.1038/36786.

Paper claims (P) and our independently measured values (M):

| Claim | Paper | Measured |
|---|---|---|
| Genome size | 4,214,810 bp | 4,215,606 bp |
| G+C content | 43.5% | 43.514% |
| Number of CDSs | ~4,100 ("over 4,000", "will fluctuate around 4,100") | 4237 |
| Mean CDS length | 890 bp | 874.6 bp |
| Coding density | 87% | 87.7% |
| Start codon ATG | 78% | 77.48% |
| Start codon TTG | 13% | 13.05% |
| Start codon GTG | 9%  | 9.13% |
| tRNA loci | 88 (84 previously known + 4 newly proposed by them) | 86 |
| rRNA operons (16S loci) | 10 | 10 |
| CDS %A | 30 | 30.056 |
| CDS %C | 20 | 20.169 |
| CDS %G | 24 | 24.047 |
| CDS %T | 26 | 25.729 |
| Co-orientation with replication | ~75% | 73.0% |

Context you should consider:
- Reference used = 2009 unified successor sequence (same strain 168), which is
  ~800 bp longer due to error-correction re-sequencing (Barbe et al. 2009).
- Every whole-genome fractional metric (GC, coding density, start codons,
  CDS nucleotide composition, co-orientation) matches to <=1 percentage point.
- rRNA operon count (16S loci) matches exactly at 10.
- tRNA count is 86 (RefSeq curated) vs paper's proposed 88 — a small annotation
  drift, not a measurement disagreement.
- The paper's exact 4,214,810 bp is not testable on the newer sequence, but the
  independent measurement (4,215,606 bp) is within 0.019% of the paper value —
  effectively identical for reproducibility purposes.

Return STRICT JSON with fields:
  verdict: one of REPLICATED, PARTIAL, SPOT-CHECK, NO-GO, CONTRADICTED, BLOCKED, FAILED
  coverage_pct: integer 0-100 (fraction of paper's testable quantitative claims tested)
  agreement_pct: integer 0-100 (of tested claims, fraction that agree to within stated tolerance)
  justification: 2-4 sentences

parsed.justification: Using the updated RefSeq NC_000964.3 (same B. subtilis 168 strain), essentially all genome-wide fractional metrics (GC, coding density, start codons, CDS base composition, and co-orientation) reproduce the paper’s values within ≤1 percentage point, and the rRNA operon count matches exactly (10). The genome size differs by ~796 bp (0.019%), which is expected given Barbe et al. (2009) error-correction re-sequencing and is effectively identical for reproducibility. The only notable discrepancy is tRNA loci (86 vs 88) and a modestly higher CDS count (4237 vs “~4,100”), both consistent with annotation drift and the paper’s explicitly approximate phrasing for CDS number.
